problemStatement.formal: f₃(n) = o(3^n) where f₃(n) = max cap set size in {0,1,2}^n
problemStatement.plain: PROVED. Furstenberg-Katznelson (1991) via density Hales-Jewett. Ellenberg-Gijswijt (2016): f₃(n) ≤ c^n for c < 3.
